symptoms_en: Bark at the base darkens, dries, shrinks and cracks in strips, then gum oozes from the trunk; the girdled bark can kill the tree. Worst where the trunk stays wet (flood irrigation, waterlogged or heavy soil).
symptoms_hi: तने के आधार की छाल काली पड़ती, सूखती, सिकुड़ती और पट्टियों में फट जाती है, फिर तने से गोंद निकलता है; छाल का घेरा कटने से पेड़ मर सकता है। यह वहाँ सबसे ज़्यादा होता है जहाँ तना गीला रहता है (बाढ़ सिंचाई, जलभराव या भारी मिट्टी)।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of citrus
symptoms_en.quote: First symptoms are dark staining of bark which progresses into the wood. Bark at the base is destroyed resulting in girdling and finally death of the tree.

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of citrus
symptoms_en.quote: Later profuse exudation of gum from the bark of the trunk.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of citrus
management_en.quote: Injuries to crown roots or base of stem during cultural operations should be avoided. If lesion has girdled less than ½ the girth, remove the diseased bark with a knife along with ½” of uninvaded bark. Bark of trunk should be coated with Bordeaux paste.

management_en: Avoid injuring crown roots or the base of the stem, and keep the trunk from sitting in water. If a lesion girdles less than half the trunk, cut away the diseased bark with a knife and coat the bark with Bordeaux paste.
management_hi: जड़ों के ऊपरी भाग और तने के आधार को चोट से बचाएँ और तने को पानी में न डूबने दें। यदि घाव आधे से कम घेरे में हो तो रोगी छाल चाकू से हटाकर बोर्डो पेस्ट लगाएँ।
